claims: The 2026 Masters is scheduled for April 9–12.
Paramount+ offers full coverage of all rounds (Thursday-Sunday) of the 2026 Masters.
Paramount+ includes early round action, third round, and final round coverage of the 2026 Masters.
ESPN+ offers live coverage of Featured Groups for the 2026 Masters.
ESPN+ offers live coverage of featured holes (Amen Corner) for the 2026 Masters.
Prime Video is new in 2026, offering exclusive, enhanced coverage of the first two rounds of the 2026 Masters.
Masters.com and the Masters App offer free streams of Featured Groups for the 2026 Masters.
Masters.com and the Masters App offer free streams of featured holes (4, 5, 6; 15, 16) for the 2026 Masters.
Masters.com and the Masters App offer free streams of the main broadcast simulcast for the 2026 Masters.
CBS and ESPN are available on YouTube TV, Hulu+ Live TV, and DirecTV.
Rounds 1 and 2 (April 9-10) of the 2026 Masters have streaming on ESPN+, Paramount+, and Prime Video.
Rounds 3 and 4 (April 11-12) of the 2026 Masters have streaming on Paramount+ and ESPN+.
CBS coverage is available for rounds 3 and 4 of the 2026 Masters.
Featured Groups and featured holes for the 2026 Masters are available daily via the Masters App, Paramount+, and Prime Video.
Final round streaming of the 2026 Masters is available on Paramount+ and CBS.
